repair_step1_text: Click the repair icon in the lower-right corner of the launcher loading screen. The program will automatically detect and fix missing or corrupted resource files.
repair_step2_text: After repair, a prompt window will appear. Click

suggestions_title: Feature Suggestions & Improvements – Let's Build Together!
suggestions_description: We value every user's feedback. Welcome to share your feature suggestions, improvement ideas, or creations here. Please keep your communication civil and friendly.
game_intro_desc1: QingFeng Launcher is a visual novel game launcher built with libGDX, following the standardized file structure defined by our development team.
game_intro_desc2: Beyond traditional dialogue-based storytelling, the core engine supports 2D map exploration, video playback, and more. The built-in visual editor enables real-time editing of story content, character dialogues, branching choices, and map scenes — no external tools required.
game_intro_desc3: QingFeng Launcher is more than a visual novel engine — it is an integrated editor + launcher platform for narrative game creation and sharing. Like Roblox, RPG Maker, or Flash, the goal is a closed-loop ecosystem where creators can create, distribute, and play in one seamless flow.
game_intro_desc4: Export games as .qfg packages with one click, ready to load and play directly. Share works with other players or publish them to the community. The launcher also supports multiple themes and multilingual interfaces to suit users from different regions.
community_description: A community space for feature suggestions, feedback, creative content sharing, and player discussions. Please keep the conversation civil!
